rationale: Most ground-truth concerns (platform scope, connector-state ownership, image-path resolution, full-payload-branch reachability, prefix-cache incompatibility) were already fixed in this diff snapshot; Y explicitly re-verifies nearly all of them with citations and additionally surfaces several new, well-grounded issues (GitHub-broken image src, understated connector-drain invariant, TP>1 collective on the background thread, YAML/ASCII nits) with concrete actionable fixes. X's single flagged finding (XPU/MUSA hash-invariance overstatement) is high-quality and precisely cited, extending the same theme ground truth raised about non-CUDA platforms, but its overall coverage of the concern space is much narrower and its verification notes stay at confirmation level rather than producing further actionable line-level fixes.
